digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud vs Data Center reconciler)
propositions: Cloud and Data Center Jira adapters lack symmetric test coverage despite sharing backend port, with gaps in both directions and differing incident-hardening histories
Data Center adapter's whole-project readers and pagination logic have never been tested beyond single-page scenarios, creating highest-risk unvalidated behavior
Duplicated ticket-type map definition exists across adapters and must be single-sourced before regression guards can be applied
Several contract tests make only shape assertions and would pass with incorrect field values, providing false confidence in adapter correctness

Cloud and DC adapters correctly diverge in rich-text handling (ADF vs wiki markup) and identity forms (accountId vs name), but test suites do not parametrize these differences with distinct expected values
